figurative_meaning_en: To compel or force someone against their will
similar_in_english: Put a gun to someone's head
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার ভাইকে গলায় গামছা দিয়ে কাজ করাতে বাধ্য করল।
এই কাজে গলায় গামছা দেওয়া ছাড়া আর কোনো উপায় নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: He forced his brother to work by putting a gamcha around his neck.
There's no way around compelling him to do this job.
note: Gamcha is a traditional Bengali towel often associated with rural life and labor.
